topLevel.why: X keeps the Preface and the Notation table as separate parts, and puts Acknowledgements and Bibliography in their own back-matter part. Y merges Preface with Notation, and its Historic Perspective part runs on through the Acknowledgements and Bibliography.

gists.why: X gives section-level gists that state what each specific section does (parallel transport, Laplace-Beltrami eigenbasis, data augmentation, time warping). Y often falls back on broad chapter-level gists that hardly touch the passage.

weldedParts.why: Absorbs the Acknowledgements (block 963) and the Bibliography (block 966 onward) into Chapter 7.
Joins the Preface essay and the separate Notation symbol table into one part.

overall.why: X divides the document cleanly at its real divisions and gives more specific, accurate gists for the sections a reader would land in.
